fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC PET Answer Key 2026 – Out – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Answer Key for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) on its official website. Applications for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) 2026 were accepted from 03 August 2026 to 07 September 2026. The examination was held from 25,30 October 2026 & 01 November 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination will be able to check and download their UPSSSC PET Answer Key 2026. The direct link to download the answer key will be provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 3 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 25, 30 October 2026 & 01 November 2026
  • Exam City Details : 12 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 17 October 2026
  • Answer Key : 02 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 185/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 95/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
